question:

```python
from Bio.PDB import PDBParser
import numpy as np

pdb_file = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7dd30055-0198-452e-8c25-f73dbe27dcb8.pdb"

parser = PDBParser(QUIET=True)
structure = parser.get_structure("prot", pdb_file)

# Collect atoms (filtering to heavy atoms in standard residues to avoid hydrogens or ligands)
atoms_filtered = []
for atom in structure.get_atoms():
    res = atom.get_parent()
    hetflag = res.get_id()[0]
    if atom.element != "H" and hetflag == " ":
        atoms_filtered.append(atom)

coord1 = atoms_filtered[0].get_coord()
coord2 = atoms_filtered[1].get_coord()

distance = float(np.linalg.norm(coord1 - coord2))
print(f"Distance between the first and second atoms: {distance:.3f} Å")
```
